TAP_rank_followup.scope: Completed AppendixF continuation and own conditional algebra, no real feature/text rank measured
TAP_rank_followup.correction: If visual/text prototype matrices X,T each have full row rank C, range((X^T T)^T)=range(T^T). Arbitrary orthogonal completion annihilates observed t_c and cannot change those aligned class names. C<d_text alone is not a reason to reject observed-class scoring.
TAP_rank_followup.low_rank_formula: Let Gx=XX^T,Gt=TT^T positive definite. Aligned named vectors Y=L X with L=Gt^(1/2)[Gt^(1/2)GxGt^(1/2)]^(-1/2)Gt^(1/2); then YY^T=Gt. Text reshapes observed class geometry inside visual-prototype span; does not by itself add query-discriminating directions outside it.
TAP_rank_followup.limits: Conditional algebra only, not verified ranks on ISIC/HK, not class1 benefit, not full TAP learned-map characterization.
